slide_title: Effect of Selecting Threshold Value on Model Performance

layout.arrangement: Title at top-left spanning most of width; slide number '25' in yellow circle at top-right; two confusion matrices stacked vertically on far left; red 'Threshold=0.6' box below title center-left; flowchart diagram center-right; scattered airplane illustrations across bottom half; horizontal red axis line at very bottom spanning width with vertical dashed threshold line near center

regions.name: confusion_matrices
regions.content: Two 2x2 tables showing TP/FP/FN/TN and numeric values 3/2/1/5

regions.name: flowchart
regions.content: Process diagram from Test Sample to Model to score to Threshold to Class I/II

regions.name: airplane_scatter
regions.content: Multiple airplane illustrations with colored dots, above horizontal axis

regions.name: axis
regions.content: Red horizontal axis with ticks at 0.0, 0.5, 1.0 and vertical dashed line

layout.hierarchy: Title is largest and most prominent (red, bold). Flowchart and confusion matrices are secondary. Airplane illustrations and axis are tertiary visual elements.

visual_elements.description: Top confusion matrix: 2x2 grid with headers 'Predicted as' (columns P, N) and 'Actual' (rows P, N). Cells contain: row P -> TP, FP; row N -> FN, TN.
Bottom confusion matrix: 2x2 grid with headers 'Predicted as' (columns P, N) and 'Actual' (rows P, N). Cells contain: row P -> 3, 2; row N -> 1, 5.
Rectangular box with light background and red border containing text 'Threshold=0.6' in red.

Horizontal process flow: 'Test Sample' (with small airplane icon) -> arrow -> 'Model' (dark red box, white text, subtitle '[Any value] - (0, +∞)') -> arrow -> '(0 --- 1)' (blue outlined box) -> arrow -> 'Threshold (e.g. 0.5)' (red outlined box) -> splits into two arrows -> 'Class I' (green oval) and 'Class II' (purple/pink oval). A purple circle with a bell-curve graph sits to the right of the Model box.

Scattered airplane illustrations (simple black line drawings) across the lower middle area. Some airplanes have small red dots, others have small blue dots. A vertical dashed blue/purple line runs through the scatter at approximately x=0.6.
Horizontal red axis line at bottom with arrowhead on right. Tick marks with labels: 0.0 at left, 0.5 at center, 1.0 at right. Vertical dashed line intersects near the 0.6 position.

imagery.description: Small airplane icon inside the 'Test Sample' box in the flowchart.
Multiple simple line-drawing airplanes scattered across the bottom half of the slide, some with red dots and some with blue dots.
Small bell-curve / distribution graph inside a purple circle next to the Model box.

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is large, bold, red, all words capitalized except prepositions. Body text is smaller, dark gray/black. Table text is centered in cells. Flowchart text is white on dark red for Model box, black elsewhere.
animation_state: All elements appear static and fully revealed; no mid-build animation visible.
recreation_brief:
1. Create a blank PowerPoint slide with white background.
2. Add title text 'Effect of Selecting Threshold Value on Model Performance' at top-left in large bold red sans-serif font (~#C62828).
3. Add a yellow circle with '25' at top-right corner.
4. On the far left, create two stacked 2x2 tables. Top table: headers 'Predicted as' over columns P, N; row header 'Actual' vertical on left; cells TP, FP / FN, TN. Bottom table: same headers; cells 3, 2 / 1, 5. Use red borders and dark text.
5. Below the title and to the right of the matrices, add a light-colored box with red border containing 'Threshold=0.6' in red text.
6. On the right side, draw a horizontal flowchart: box 'Test Sample' with small airplane icon -> arrow -> dark red box 'Model' with white text and subtitle '[Any value] - (0, +∞)' -> arrow -> blue-outlined box '(0 --- 1)' -> arrow -> red-outlined box 'Threshold (e.g. 0.5)' -> two diverging arrows -> green oval 'Class I' and purple oval 'Class II'. Add a purple circle with a bell curve icon to the right of the Model box.
7. Across the bottom half, scatter approximately 12-14 simple black line-drawing airplanes. Add small red dots to some and small blue dots to others.
8. Draw a vertical dashed purple/blue line through the airplanes at approximately the 0.6 position.
9. At the very bottom, draw a horizontal red axis line with an arrowhead on the right. Add tick marks and labels '0.0', '0.5', '1.0' in black text below the axis.
